note: Switch "warFocus" (the war and geopolitics focus, council of 2026-11-27, docs/council/2026-11-27-war-and-geopolitics.md): a war as an object with aims, a ledger of named events, weariness on both sides and peace with terms; Carthage's return after a revolt, its landings announced a season ahead, and a pendulum that unites its council when you hold much of the island.
